_comment: Aura Farming — Tomato Disease Class Mapping
_status: VERIFIED — Folder names confirmed from PlantVillage GitHub repository (raw/color/) via GitHub API. Integer indices are project-defined (0-based, alphabetical by folder name). Final counts must be confirmed by running training/inspect_dataset.py against the downloaded dataset.
_license: PlantVillage dataset: CC BY-SA 3.0. Cite: Mohanty, Hughes & Salathe (2016), Frontiers in Plant Science, doi:10.3389/fpls.2016.01419
_download: Recommended: Hugging Face Hub — load_dataset('mohanty/PlantVillage', 'color'). Alternative: git clone https://github.com/spMohanty/PlantVillage-Dataset then find images under raw/color/
_index_procedure: Indices are assigned alphabetically by PlantVillage folder name. The training pipeline must use this mapping explicitly — never infer indices from os.listdir() sort order. This file is the single source of truth for label indices.

0.notes: GitHub API returns 1000 max; actual count confirmed locally by inspect_dataset.py

1.notes: GitHub API returned exactly 1000 — may be capped. Actual count confirmed locally.

3.notes: Note: 'Mold' capitalised, 'Leaf' capitalised in folder name

5.notes: CRITICAL: folder name contains a SPACE between 'mites' and 'Two-spotted'. Must be handled carefully in path construction.

7.notes: Largest class — significant class imbalance risk

8.notes: Smallest class — only 373 images. Monitor for class imbalance during training.

plantdoc_label_map._comment: Maps PlantDoc label strings to Aura Farming class indices (0–9). To be verified in Phase 3 after PlantDoc label inspection. Not used until Phase 7 generalization evaluation.
